verdict.rationale: 1Password documents official SDKs for Go, JavaScript, and Python for building programmatic integrations [1password-docs-26]. Documented use cases include loading secrets via secret references or Environments [1password-docs-7] and managing items programmatically [1password-docs-8]. An official GitHub repo for the JS SDK backs this up [1password-gh-1]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage, and deeper evidence of the SDK API surface and coverage beyond the overview snippets.
